messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "initiate Wegovy injection with a dose of 0.25 mg injected subcutaneously once weekly"
set: ["initiate Wegovy injection with a dose of 0.25 mg injected subcutaneously once weekly", "start with 0.25 mg subcutaneous injection once weekly for 4 weeks", "one dose is injected weekly", "reduce dose to 1.7 mg once weekly", "increase dosage to 0.5 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.25 mg", "once weekly", "increase to 5 mg subcutaneously once a week after 4 weeks", "rotate injection sites with each dose", "re-escalate to 2.4 mg once weekly if lower dose is tolerated", "initial dose 10 mg orally once a day", "taper dose to 150 mg once a day", "starting dose is 12.5 mg capsule once a day", "injected into a vein by a healthcare provider", "give once weekly at any time of day, with or without meals", "maintenance dose 10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "can be started with an injection into a muscle"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
